notes: Sorbents are wheat-straw biochars pyrolysed at 700, 800 and 900 °C; H2 measured by Sieverts (PCT Pro) at 30 °C to about 66 bar (3D plot, Fig. 8 upper panel) and at liquid-nitrogen temperature for the 900 °C biochar (Fig. 8 lower panel, 6 points to about 47 bar). The biochar's carbon content is not reported (raw straw 42.30 wt% C, 3.60 wt% ash, Table 1; XRD shows SiO2, Fe2O3, KCl, SiC peaks in 700 and 800 °C biochar); I2 judged met because the sorbent is a pyrolysis char. Internal inconsistency: abstract gives 15.29 mol/kg at 46.21 bar at cryogenic temperature, whereas Section 3.4 and Conclusions give 15.59 mol/kg at 46.71 bar. BET areas were measured with Ar at −185.86 °C. Uptake basis not named. No retraction, review or prior-publication statement found.
